description: Land Acquisition - Maoya, Laggala D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including their boundaries, extents, and survey details. While it mentions a government minister (John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands), this is incidental to the main purpose of the notice, which is about land acquisition. The content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments with detailed portfolios, or any of the other specialized categories. The document is explicitly labeled as "PART III - LANDS" and "Land Acquisition Notices," confirming its primary focus on land matters.
